_about: SCENERY ON A RING: FALLEN LOGS ON THE BANK, STUMPS ON THE TOP BANK.
A ring's 'features' names bank feature DEFINITIONS, not placed features. A definition is a file in
config/streamsreflowing/bank_features/ with a 'features' list and no biomes or tags. Its id is its file name.
This style uses two. Copy riverside_logs.json and riverside_stumps.json from bank_features/examples/ into
bank_features/ as well, or the rings have nothing to place.
In a datapack a definition is data/<namespace>/streamsreflowing/bank_feature/<name>.json, and its id is <namespace>:<name>.
chance: the percent of the bank sites the mod samples in that ring that get one. Keep it low, 1 to 5.
